description:
## Features

Ported from [Morphe](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches).

### YouTube
- **Copy text:** Long-press a video title or comment to copy its text.
- **Volume boost:** Swipe volume past its normal maximum for up to 200% in the overlay. Uses Android's Loudness Enhancer; loud audio may distort.
- **Skip silence:** Automatically skip silent pauses, with a selectable minimum pause length.
- **Comments:** Hide Menu, Translate or Dislike buttons; use a minimal comments button.
- **Feed:** Hide the History shelf, live streams or channel names in the subscribed-channels bar.
- **Disable auto feed refresh:** Prevent automatic feed reloads when returning to the app.
- **Action buttons:** Hide the channel and Subscribe button together, or only Subscribe.
- **Description:** Hide the Ask Gemini button in the Ask panel.
- **Layout:** Hide Help & feedback in app-bar menus.
- **Navigation:** Hide the new-content dot.
- **Hide status bar:** Swipe down from the top edge to show it temporarily.
- **SponsorBlock:** Show each category's skip behavior in its settings summary.

### YouTube Music
- **Skip silence:** Automatically skip silent pauses, with a selectable minimum pause length.
- **Layout:** Hide the podcast episode Download button; the floating-button setting also hides the Library tab's New button in newer layouts.
- **Force portrait orientation.**
- **Media notification controls:** Hide previous/next buttons and disable the seekbar.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.
- Skip silence requires YouTube **20.49+** or YouTube Music **9.00+**; its hooks and settings are omitted on older targets.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.5.1...v1.6.0)
